about.title: About Excel Air
text: Excel Air is a family-owned HVAC service company that caters primarily to clients in and around Houston, TX. We’ve been in business for eight years now. However, our founders are backed by more than three decades’ worth of industry experience! This is what allows us to take on all kinds of residential and commercial HVAC projects. In fact, whether you just need some minor adjustments or a full-on heating and cooling system installation, we’ve got you covered.

What sets us apart from the rest is our strong commitment to customer satisfaction. We follow a hands-on approach when it comes to orders, no matter how big or small the job is. It’s our team’s mission to ensure your indoor air quality is up to standard 24/7.
